## Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta4

### Stable vendor trail with a short live MQTT tail

- Keep the integration-owned `current_cycle_render` / vendor-retained mowing footprint as the visual backbone of the current cycle.
- When the backend marks its MQTT tail authoritative, render only the newest **8 m** of that live tail instead of allowing the browser-side session trail to grow across the vendor footprint.
- Preserve normal legacy/session rendering when vendor retained geometry is not available.
- Mark the authoritative live polyline as `mqtt-live-tail-short` for field diagnostics.

This beta is intended to remove the visible switching between the vendor-retained footprint and the longer Home Assistant/MQTT-built trail while keeping the mower position visually connected to the most recent vendor update.
